name: Minimum
description: Smoother GD: draw divide style render, background volume on tab out, parallel batches, particle and streak opts, fast level enter exit.

mod-enabled.name: Enable Minimum
mod-enabled.description: Master switch. Toggle in a level with no restart.

performance-mode.name: Performance Mode
performance-mode.description: Strongest opts including draw divide and particle smooth.

draw-divide.name: Draw Divide
draw-divide.description: Like mat.draw-divide. Renders at Visual FPS while game logic keeps full speed. Helps GPU lag with high FPS bypass.

visual-fps.name: Visual FPS
visual-fps.description: Target render FPS when Draw Divide is on. Set to your monitor Hz for best results.

background-volume.name: Lower Volume When Tabbed Out
background-volume.description: Reduces music and SFX when the game loses focus so YouTube and other apps are easier to hear.

background-volume-scale.name: Background Volume Scale
background-volume-scale.description: Volume multiplier when tabbed out. 0 is mute, 0.2 is quiet, 1 is full.

fast-level-exit.name: Fast Level Exit
fast-level-exit.description: Stops particles and skips non forced save on quit.

fast-level-enter.name: Fast Level Enter
fast-level-enter.description: Warms thread pool early for smoother first frames.

skip-empty-batch.name: Skip Empty Batches
skip-empty-batch.description: Skip draw for empty sprite batches.

parallel-batch.name: Parallel Batch Transforms
parallel-batch.description: Thread pool transform updates for large batches.

parallel-threshold.name: Parallel Threshold
parallel-threshold.description: Child count before parallel transforms run.

limit-particles.name: Limit Particle Count
limit-particles.description: Hard cap per system every frame.

reduce-emission.name: Reduce Particle Emission
reduce-emission.description: Lower spawn rate to cut spikes.

smooth-particles.name: Smooth Particles
smooth-particles.description: Update offscreen systems every other frame.

cull-streaks.name: Cull Offscreen Streaks
cull-streaks.description: Skip streak update and draw off screen.

anti-aliasing.name: Anti Aliasing
anti-aliasing.description: MSAA 0 off to 4. Keep 0 for max FPS.
